content:
Updated the patch source to match the composite schema and added an explicit RDS readiness check.

### `composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: aws-web-service
  labels:
    crossplane.io/xrd: xawswebservices.app.example.com
spec:
  group: app.example.com
  mode: Pipeline
  resources:
    - name: rds-instance
      base:
        apiVersion: database.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
        kind: Instance
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: us-east-1
            engine: postgres
            engineVersion: "16.1"
            allocatedStorage: 20
          providerConfigRef:
            name: default
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.instanceClass
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
          transforms:
            - type: String
              string:
                type: Format
                format: "db.t3.%s"
      readinessChecks:
        - type: MatchCondition
          matchCondition:
            type: Ready
            status: "True"
```

### `xrd.yaml`

The XRD must expose the same `spec.parameters.instanceClass` path used by the Composition:

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xawswebservices.app.example.com
spec:
  group: app.example.com
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    instanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: medium
                  required:
                    - instanceClass
                deletionProtection:
                  type: boolean
                  default: true
              required:
                - parameters
  claimNames:
    kind: AWSWebService
    plural: awswebservices
```

The parameter value is the class suffix, such as `micro` or `medium`; the existing transform produces `db.t3.micro` or `db.t3.medium`. The readiness check now waits for the managed RDS resource’s `Ready=True` condition.
